fee_hurdle.spread_detail: paper_mark is public_mid_or_last(...) — the mid whenever both sides are quoted — and the payout is 1/mark, so the book buys at the mid and is paid at the mid while the RUN-ONLY note charges a taker fee. A taker pays the ask.
fee_hurdle.spread_cost_per_dollar_stake: s / (p + s); about $0.010 per fill at p=0.50 on a one-cent book, about $0.020 on a two-cent book — the same order as the $0.039 mean fee
fee_hurdle.spread_cost_direction: AT A CONSTANT TICK, s/(p+s) DECREASES in p ($0.0164 at p=0.30, $0.0099 at 0.50, $0.0055 at 0.90), so AT A CONSTANT TICK it runs the same direction as the fee, not the opposite. AT A CONSTANT TICK a band skip avoids neither cost's worst region.
fee_hurdle.spread_tick_premise_contradicted_by: golf_offshoot.data_feeds.kalshi_15m.PRICE_LEVEL_STRUCTURE = 'tapered_deci_cent' (written onto every market row and paper movement). A tapered tick is finer at the extremes and coarser in the middle, which is the geometry that can restore an increasing s toward 0.50. The direction of the spread cost near 0.50 is therefore UNKNOWN, not settled.
